svg.text: Exact net labels govern wiring. GPS supply is conditional. Power off before assembly.
J2.1 RX48 ← GPS TXD; J2.4 → GPS GND
GPS: identify actual VCC / GND / TXD pads.
Conditional power: J7.2 5V → VCC only if rated for 5V.
Verify 3.3V UART compatibility; RXD/PPS unused; GPS antenna.
INA226: VBS → IN−; A0/A1 → GND for 0x40.
Verify shunt; ALE unused. See high-side circuit below.
J7 rear view as photographed: left → right; top row toward PCB, bottom row toward board edge
Derived from V1.2 Eagle J7 footprint (R90) and netlist. Confirm rails and physical orientation before connecting.
Source + → IN+ → fitted shunt → IN− → Load +
IN− → VBS | Source − = Load − = module GND
VCC is 3.3V logic supply. Sense inputs: 0–36V maximum.
Shunt value / current / resistor power rating must be checked.
RX: RXEN=1, TXEN=0 TX: RXEN=0, TXEN=1
DIO2: leave unconnected. ANT: short 50Ω RF feed.
J7 remains the selected LoRa connection.
Crossings are not junctions. Wires are schematic connections, not suggested physical cable routes.
Photo endpoints are visual guides; the labelled J-pin / module-pin wiring table in docs/wiring.md is authoritative.
Original photographs are embedded unchanged. GPS power and shunt calibration remain conditional.
